messages:
sara_sre: Heads up — after the proxy rollout the latency console for us-east is only showing mean/median. p95/p99 curves are gone from the timeseries view, customers are escalating about missing tails.

alex_dev: Which dashboard exactly? link?

sara_sre: /console/metrics/latency?env=prod&region=us-east — open for last 6h, p95/p99 are blank lines (not flat, absent).

infra-bot: Deploy finished: proxy-canary -> proxy-v3.14 at 10:16 UTC (canary -> prod cutover 10:17).

jordan_prod: I hit the backend query for quantiles and the analytics service returned empty for quantiles. pasted small log:```
2026-03-17T10:18:19Z ERROR quantile_agg: no samples for key=service=llm-infer region=us-east
2026-03-17T10:18:19Z DEBUG api: /api/observability/query payload={\"metric\":\"latency\",\"quantiles\": [0.95,0.99]} response=200 body={\"metric\":\"latency\",\"quantiles\": null,\"series\": {\"avg\": [...], \"p50\": [...]}}
```

samir_support: We already have two urgent tickets — fintech-app and search-pro complaining p99 spike not visible. They saw a big customer-facing incident and can't reconcile our numbers.

alex_dev: Can you run the internal query directly? e.g.:
```
curl -s -X POST 'https://internal-analytics/api/query' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' -d '{"metric":"latency","quantiles":[0.95,0.99],"start":"-6h"}' | jq .
```

jordan_prod: Ran it. Response:```
{"metric":"latency","quantiles":null,"series":{"avg":[120,130,110],"p50":[100,110,95]}}
```

alex_dev: That suggests the quantile calculation path was disabled or the aggregator returned null for quantiles. I'm checking ingestion/job config.

jordan_prod: Found a rollout change: a temporary feature flag was added to skip heavy quantile computations during the proxy canary: `skip_quantiles_for_proxy_v3` — it appears to have been toggled to true globally during rollout by the release script. Oops.

sara_sre: So the dashboard queries succeeded but backend returned quantiles=null, meaning the front-end hides the lines. Can we flip the flag for prod/us-east ASAP?

jordan_prod: Yes. Hitting ops-flags API now.

deploy-bot: Feature flag change requested: skip_quantiles_for_proxy_v3 = false by jordan_prod at 10:27 UTC.

infra-bot: Flag propagation to analytics: ok (10:28), queuing reaggregation for last 6h for region=us-east.

jordan_prod: Triggered reaggregation job: /ops/reaggregate?metric=latency&region=us-east&window=6h

alex_dev: Heads-up: recompute will take ~5-20m depending on partitions. dashboard should show quantiles once series rebuilt.

jordan_prod: Confirmed p95/p99 reappeared at ~10:45 UTC for the affected window.

sara_sre: Verified on console — p95/p99 lines back. I'll update the support tickets and let customers know it's fixed.

samir_support: Created internal ticket INC-1234 with customer notes and timeline. Notifying customers now.

alex_dev: Root cause summary: feature flag intended to be canary-only was promoted to global during rollout automation. That disabled quantile computation path in the aggregator, returning null for quantiles.

sara_sre: Action items: 1) Rollback the default for skip_quantiles_for_proxy_v3 to false in release scripts, 2) add a safeguard so flags set in canary don't auto-promote, 3) add dashboard e2e check that verifies p95/p99 presence for latency, 4) postmortem + customer timeline. I'll start a postmortem doc.

jordan_prod: I'll add an infra alert that fires when queries return quantiles=null for >1m across a region.

sara_sre: Thanks everyone. I'll ping when postmortem is ready and after customer updates are sent. :white_check_mark:
